# Evelin H1 1661 canonical diff

Compared files:

- Canonical filed/importing fixture: `H1_BG005100_1661.XML`
- Superseded generated draft: `H1_BG005100_2026091401A_DRAFT.XML`

## Structural differences

| Area | Draft | Canonical 1661 | Action |
|---|---|---|---|
| Goods items | 17 | 18 | Split zinc bisglycinate and selenomethionine into separate tariff items. |
| N325 | First item only | Every item | Canonical client profile now injects N325 for every item. |
| 1999 certificates | Five per item | Four per item | Canonical client profile now injects exactly `СЕРТИФИКАТИ1` through `СЕРТИФИКАТИ4`. |
| N337 previous document | Draft placeholder | Required item at shipment level | Export is blocked by Evelin canonical conformance until a nonblank N337 reference is provided. |
| Description maximum | General 512 characters | 268 characters observed in 1661 | Canonical profile enforces 268. |
| Exporter bounds | Earlier fixture-derived 26/45 | 36 name / 56 street characters | Evelin canonical profile uses the proved 1661 bounds. |

`ARRIVALTRANSPORTMEANS` and the actual `N337` reference are shipment facts. They remain required in structure but must never be copied from 1661 into another shipment.

## Persistent controls added

- `H1_BG005100_1661_CANONICAL.XML` is retained byte-for-byte as the Evelin fixture.
- `evelin29.canonical.json` binds each verified HS code to its exact declaration description and CAS numbers where present.
- The transformer gives canonical descriptions precedence over generated wording.
- The Evelin client profile injects the exact item document pattern.
- Conformance rejects missing canonical documents, missing N337, overlong descriptions, and overlong party fields for Evelin.
- `tests/evelin-canonical.test.ts` fails if fixture HS, description, CAS, document pattern, or bounds drift.
